title: A WO demo carries the restaurant's sourced words in the template's own slots (hero, About story, dish cards) and its contact facts, written by the build without a model
steps: S1: build a WO demo brief with name, bio, story post, dishes and contact facts; run each engine (EmDash Base/Business, Joomla j6 and WordPress wp7 Base/Business) against a fake site.
S2: send collected contact facts to the create door, with and without a customer answer for the same detail, and with a malformed one.
S3: rerun the EmDash step after the tool rewrote the fields; make a publish fail, then retry; move an entry between read and write.

S4: run the local editorial selector tests with an account mismatch, review and time-bound sources, an invented passage, a changed input/template, a changed accepted value, and a bounded reasoning transport.

S5: validate synthetic opening-hours/promotion predicates, conflicting contacts, wine/whisky identity, crop/coverage, blind-review evidence, and executor/model protocol failures. No live receiver capability is inferred from these mocks.

S6: with TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing to owned test Postgres, run registry and Ops role tests: independent woEditorial/vision assignments, supported effort persistence and outbound options, pixel proof invalidation, paid failure/crash/idempotency and admin/Origin guards.
S7: run quality intent, protocol queue, frozen overlay, installed inventory and bounded CMS client tests; simulate interrupted rename/restore and later human edits.

S8: run the composed editorial/fill/render/review, monetary headroom and local stand transport tests; release the real demo queue claim before asynchronous normalizer and native SSE usage arrive, then simulate repair against a later human edit.

S9: test explicit QA Retry acceptance and request identities on actual Postgres, frozen bounded execution profiles, native streaming guard monitoring, and granted public snapshot media reads with real PNG bytes in isolated scratch data.

S10: test lossless facts-wire packing and immutable bounded-v3 limits; compose separate Dubai DB/media/app/release scopes through one paid authority, covering real Postgres Stop/claim races, legacy asynchronous admission, fixed roots and frozen model reloads.
expect: S1: mapped slots get the sourced value (hero title = name, lead = bio sentence, CTA only with phone/booking, story into About/Mission, dishes into cards only when the whole group fits); the model is not asked for pinned Joomla/WordPress slots; roles with no source are left alone; receipts and the words before are kept.
S2: facts reach the identity writers verbatim without a model; the customer's own answer wins; a malformed fact is dropped with a note; no facts reads as before.
S3: re-Apply writes our words again keeping the first words before; a failed publish is completed on retry without a second write; a moved entry is left as conflict.

S4: the selector excludes forbidden sources, binds the exact archive and frozen source text, refuses invented or changed inputs, derives CMS values from exact source spans, preserves identity/CTA, and enables reasoning in one bounded provider call.

S5: relabelled opening-hours claims, unverified whisky identity, incomplete groups, missing/stale review evidence and unaudited receivers are refused; bounded model transport retains paid failure usage without secrets or reasoning content. Real EmDash CAS discovery remains a separately reported blocker.

S6: dossier/planner use WO editorial and persisted canonical effort; observations/review require independent vision assignment and current pixel proof. seedText/draw assignments remain unchanged. Unsupported effort, absent capabilities, stale proof and unauthorized test requests are refused. Retries do not duplicate dispatched paid calls.

S7: revisions and model/key changes share repair, attempt and job limits; accepted A to B to A has distinct generations. Account/protocol scopes fence claim and exhaustion. Installed IDs and locale policies are explicit; unaudited term/slug writes and intercepted routes refuse. Lost responses grant no restoration ownership.

S8: all stage adapters retain account/root/model/input fences; budget denial dispatches nothing, background ownership survives wait without accepting an old execution, review never drops readable route coverage, and repair refuses stale content or replacement installed IDs. Stop and uncertain states prevent later writes or model calls.

S9: fill Retry cannot authorize a later QA reset; acceptance and resume CAS the exact failed generation and duplicate requests retain one prompt. New accepted QA actions have distinct repair RPCs. Missing execution profiles retain legacy limits and bytes; the new profile forecasts 197 cents and preserves every capture. Streaming checks Stop and permissions without Docker per chunk. Media grants, expiry, withdrawal, bytes and timeout fail closed without exposing object keys.

S10: compact facts preserve every exact source span and candidate reference; old v1/v2 hashes and limits stay unchanged, new facts output is bounded at 12000 tokens. Dubai cannot mint a replacement root or hide old account jobs from the shared cap. Stop, expired/revoked grants, stale claims, model/proof/price changes and foreign app/host scopes refuse before paid egress. Source cache always rechecks live canonical authority. Normal legacy bindings survive unrelated queue wait/rotation; candidate retains its real queue lease. Consumer never receives provider, release or object-store credentials. Live pilot visual quality is separate evidence, not inferred from fixtures.
evidence: Before: WO sent only name and a 300-character about; contact facts from Google never reached the site and the model wrote hero/About/services from that about (survey 19/10/2026).
fence: sourced values only, map per template x CMS checked against the real contract/seed, no model for pinned slots, receipts + words before kept, WO builds only

tests: every mapped field is a field of the seed it names, of a kind the writer knows
Tracy Base: hero title, lead and button on the home page, the story on About; no dish cards
Tracy Business: the name is the whole hero title; the dishes become the service cards, numbers kept
fewer dishes than cards writes no card: a dish never sits beside the model’s service lines
a role with no source is skipped; an entry with nothing to write is not listed
written: the fields are published, read back, their words before kept once, a receipt per entry
re-Apply: the tool rewrote the fields since the first build; ours are written again, the first words before kept
conflict: the entry moved between our read and our write; one fresh read, then it is left alone
publish failed: the draft is kept, and the retry finds it and publishes it without writing again
idempotent: a rerun that finds the words already published writes nothing and says written
the EmDash engine writes the pinned words after the personalize tool and reports what it did
collected facts are the contact details as sent, with no model, and say where they came from
what the customer said wins over a collected fact; a model never replaces one
a collected fact that does not look like one is dropped, with a note saying why
no collected facts: the brief reads as it always did, with no provenance field
place input is account scoped and excludes review and temporal claims
a map pointing outside the exact seed is refused before a model call
invented, repeated, missing, unsupported and oversized selections fail closed
compiler rederives the text and refuses template changes after planning
reasoning client makes one bounded call and never sends the seed writer disabled-thinking setting
official website sentences have exact snapshot provenance; promotional pages stay out
a numeric opening-hours claim cannot be relabelled happy hour using the same source
happy-hour and whisky findings need real render evidence and prevent a pass
an unaudited CMS refuses before any CMS read or write
missing screenshots, missing mobile coverage, stale content and invalid JSON cannot pass
the adapter sends pixel blocks with reasoning enabled and preserves usage on malformed JSON
roles and effort persist on reload without changing seedText or draw-image assignments
missing/disabled read assignment and draws capability never authorize WO vision
ops pixel test uses only saved assignment, requires admin and origin, and reuses its paid receipt
rebuild and model/key rotation share repair, attempts and the job budget
accepted A to B to A has three generations; stale acceptance cannot replace current input
one record resumes from its published receipt before rename and restores both data and URL
installation binding retains actual IDs and explicit absent-locale policy without pretending render coverage
term and slug writes require matching image proofs and use bounded native requests
C2 refuses evidence expansion and image reinterpretation, even with a valid asset id
restart finalizes the persisted preparation and refuses a different editorial reference on replay
the normal quality queue creates without a legacy brief and the default worker cannot take its row
revocation after preparation and object replacement fail before a repeated vision or upload use
accepted QA actions on one build use distinct repair RPCs for both finite rounds
